title: BodySettings
description: Data file content/body/settings.json (B5-11, spec Bogen 30 R29/R30, D1084): what the weather does to an inhabitant's body beyond the air - rain wets it unless it is under shelter, it dries by a table over the temperature (faster in wind), and being wet cools; the sun warms where nothing casts shade (trees by shade_height_cm and crown_radius_cm in the direction of the sun table, no angle functions). All numbers are data; no fear of water (R30), no behaviour - what an inhabitant does about it stays with the decider (B2584).

wind.description: B5 R4: wind feels colder (at full wind cool_tenth_c), less where a thing with wind_block_permille stands within block_radius_cm. Absent = wind is not felt.

climbing.description: D1105 H3b: climbing what gives grip (a thing with grip_permille and shade_height_cm). The action climbs the thing itself or, aimed at a thing up high, the nearest plant of the kind it grows on (spawn data). Below min_grip_permille the try fails honestly (out_of_reach, too_smooth). The height reached comes from height_by_grip (linear between its points), at most the thing's height; while the climber stays within stay_within_m of it (up_minutes at most) its reach grows by that height, for that thing and what grows on it. Above the reach height every metre adds slip_permille_per_m to the chance of slipping (stream body/<inhabitant>): it slides gently down (event slipped) with a fright (mood + delta), never hurt. Absent = nobody climbs.

stay_within_m.description: Farther than this from what it climbed, the climber is down again.

stay_sheltered.description: A1744 (B2790 b): whoever is under a shelter (wetness.shelter_property within shelter_radius_cm) while precipitation falls there (in_precipitation) or while it feels one of at_levels (comfort levels) weighs what leads out of the shelter by leaving_factor_permille - a thing, a person or a walk outside; what stays inside keeps its weight. A weight, never a ban. Absent = no difference.

others_warmth.description: B5 R4: the body warmth of other inhabitants near, each warming by tenth_c at its place, falling off linearly to nothing at radius_cm. Absent = none.

experiences.description: B5 R37: what an inhabitant finds out from what it feels near a thing - a belief with source experienced about the thing's TRUE property, by the one path of experience (B2672 F8). Nowhere a rule like 'cold -> seek fire': only what was felt near what.

felt_places.description: B5 R32 (D1099): the inhabitant remembers how a place felt - the latest feeling per grid square, a few places, forgotten after a while. Absent = no such memory.

experience_every_minutes.description: How often, in game minutes, what is felt near things is taken in.

worn.description: K4 (B2752): a worn thing with this true property adds warmth to the air its wearer feels (tenths of a degree). Warmth only through the material, never through the function.

cover.description: How much a shade caster covers, by type and season (TL #25357: a broad-leaved tree in winter little): it dims the sun in its shade and the rain under its crown. A caster or season not listed covers fully (1000).

property.description: True property of the worn thing that keeps warm.

warm_tenth_c.description: Tenths of a degree the wearer feels warmer.

up_to_tenth_c.description: Review GW1 #436: the worn thing keeps warm only while the air and sun its wearer feels without it are below this (tenths of a degree) - on a hot day it adds nothing. Omitted = always.

rain_per_hour.description: How fast rain wets an inhabitant out in the open, in permille of fully wet per game hour.

in_water_per_hour.description: How fast standing or wading in water (a map cell with water: lake, stream, shallow sea) wets an inhabitant, in permille of fully wet per game hour; sheltering does not help (A1793, Marcel 15a). Omitted = water does not wet. Placeholder value.

drying.description: How fast a wet inhabitant dries, by the air temperature: the first band whose below_tenth_c is above the temperature; the last (below_tenth_c null) takes the rest.

wind_drying_permille.description: Extra drying at full wind, in permille of the band's rate.

wet_from_permille.description: From this wetness on an inhabitant counts as wet in its request to the AI (environment.wet). Omitted = 1.

cool_tenth_c.description: How much colder it feels when fully wet, in tenths of a degree (linear with the wetness).

shelter_property.description: The TRUE property of things that keep the rain off whoever stands at them.

shelter_radius_cm.description: How near such a thing must be.

per_hour.description: Permille of fully wet that dries per game hour.

cell_m.description: Size of a place: a grid square of this many metres (floor of the position).

max.description: Places remembered per inhabitant; beyond it the oldest is forgotten (ties by place).

forget_hours.description: A remembered feeling is forgotten after this many game hours.

from_comfort.description: Which feeling (vocabulary felt) a comfort level gives.

wet.description: The feeling while it is wet there (before the comfort level); omitted = none.

kept_dry.description: The feeling when a thing there kept it dry in the rain (before everything else); omitted = none.

felt.description: warmth: a thing near warms the inhabitant by at least min_tenth_c; kept_dry: in the rain a thing near keeps it dry.

property.description: The property it finds out about the thing (its truth, as the world has it).

min_tenth_c.description: warmth: how much warmer at least, in tenths of a degree.

warm_tenth_c.description: How much warmer it feels in the sun under a clear sky, in tenths of a degree (less with clouds, none in shade).

positions.description: Where the sun stands, by season and hour: the latest entry of the season at or before the hour holds; before the first and from an entry without a direction on, the sun is down.

toward_x_permille.description: Direction the shadows fall (x part); null with z null = the sun is down.

shadow_permille.description: Length of a shadow per height (low sun: long shadows).
